_readme: Markers for the Map of Eryndor page. Coordinates are pixels on the full-size source image (10240 x 5760).
To find coordinates: open the map page, press the 'Coordinates' button, click a spot (or a numbered unnamed dot), and paste the copied snippet below.
Fields: name (shown on the map), type (region | capital | city | town | village | landmark), x, y.
Optional: nation (shown in the popup), blurb (one sentence in the popup), page (lore page title, or /slug, if it differs from name), minZoom (override when this marker appears).
Links are resolved automatically by matching 'page' (or 'name') against lore page titles. 'types' sets the zoom level at which each kind of marker appears.
